_comment: Fitness creator just crossed 50K followers. Currently runs brand-deals + affiliate. Trigger: milestone-50k. Playbook says merch + email-list. Proposal includes both, with email-list as the universal anchor.

proposals.why: Off-platform capture is the universal next move at 50K — algorithm risk is highest here.
firstSteps: Add a fitness-related lead magnet (e.g. '4-week starter program PDF')
Drop the link in your bio + pin a Reel announcing it

proposals.why: Per fitness playbook at 50K: lean apparel + shaker bottle launch via Bonfire.
firstSteps: Design 1 hoodie + 1 shaker bottle on Bonfire (no inventory risk)
Pre-launch to your email list 1 week before public
Hard 7-day launch window — scarcity drives conversion

antiPatterns: Don't launch supplements at 52K — supply chain + FDA risk eats margin pre-scale.
